name: Crab
style: chibi cube pet, deliberately blocky (Kenney Cube Pets); stylized size: 0.18 m tall, which makes the claw-tip span about 0.3 m, the width of a large edible crab (a 15-20 cm shell plus raised claws), so it sits at a 1.7 m adult's ankle; the cube body is far taller than a real crab's flat shell, so the height follows the width, not the other way round; rigid parts moved by node tracks, no skin; colour map flattened to flat colours

source.author: Kenney (kenney.nl)
source.note: Wave-1 row 45 names this model (Kenney Cube Pets, animal-crab.glb). The Crab from Quaternius's Textured Cute Monster Pack (Aug 2020, OpenGameArt, CC0) was rendered as an alternative and rejected: it is a round blob with flat paddle claws, many stub legs and a monster face (dark eye sockets, teeth), and its near-black maroon texture flattens to 12 near-identical reds. The Cube Pets crab has two raised pincers, legs, a red shell and a clear cartoon face, and reads as a crab at a glance; it is deliberately blocky. Colour map flattened to 20 clusters (at 12 the dark leg undersides fell into the pupil cluster and showed as black wedges): the slate pupil-and-mouth cluster #4b4e5c -> eye, the white #ededf4 -> white (eye whites), the 17 red clusters -> shell. Ground: run hops and its landings sink up to 4 mm, so it clamps; walk is a bouncy trot that never sinks and is left as authored; eat tips the whole body forward so its front edge dips 7 mm through the ground while the back legs stay planted (sinkAllowed). Ingested through Blender like the other Cube Pets.

eat.sinkAllowed: the body tips forward to eat and its front edge dips 7 mm through the ground while the back legs stay planted (clamping would float the crab)
